title: Production of biofuel from wood hydrolysates using oleaginous yeast Cutaneotrichosporon curvatus
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01114K, Paper
Stephanie Ossai, Sampath Gunukula, Gerard Peter van Walsum, Somtochukwu Anonyuo, Ravi Patil, M. Clayton Wheeler, C. Luke Williams
Dilute sugar hydrolysates from pretreated pine were converted to microbial lipids using C. curvatus, followed by hydrothermal liquefaction to bio-oil with heating values up to 37 MJ kg−1, demonstrating an integrated route to fuel intermediates.
